name: Read a brief
about: A deck, photos or notes become the asset list: every item the brief calls for, with the slide or photo it comes from, matched to the Library or marked missing. Each missing item has a Make button (Make an Object), and each made Object can be detailed next (Detail an Object). Since 2.0.0 Innowa reads it with you in the chat (R115) and asks what the brief leaves unclear.
useWhen: The owner has a brief (a deck, photos, drawings or notes) and wants the list of what it calls for, with what the Library already has and what is missing.

input.about: The brief: a deck (PDF), photos or drawings, and any notes. In a project, from its files; in the studio, added when you start the run (kept with the run).

rules.text: Every Need cites its evidence: the file and page (or photo) it came from, or the line of the notes.
Every Need gets one outcome with a reason: matched to a Library Object, an Object to adapt (with the parameters that change), or missing.

Agents never change the Library or a project's model. They write the run's Needs, matches and draft Objects; only the owner's decisions change anything: Keep (in a project) or Propose (in the studio, each Object by its own Propose to Library run and pull request).
Measure in millimetres. When a size is not given, use a usual size for the kind of thing and say so in the Need's notes.

steps.name: Read
steps.outcome: The brief becomes a list of Needs, each with its evidence.
instructions: Tell the owner in one or two sentences how many Needs you found, and ask about anything the brief leaves unclear that changes the list (a quantity, which of two options) rather than guessing.

steps.name: Match
steps.outcome: Every Need is matched to a Library Object, an Object to adapt, or marked missing, with a reason.
instructions: When you are done, tell the owner that the asset list on the run page has a Make button for each missing one.

output.name: Asset list
output.about: Every item the brief calls for with its evidence, what it matched in the Library, and a Make button for each missing one.
